text:
maria: quick PSA: node sample app dropped request IDs when jobs hit the worker. handler shows X-Request-Id but worker prints a different one.

sam: which queue lib? and are you expecting OTEL auto-propagation to handle it?

maria: using bullmq. we relied on otel autoinstrumentation + a tiny middleware that sets X-Request-Id on the http request. didn't inject into job payload.

jordan: queues break in-process contexts. python/celery historically shipped traceparent in task headers. node's auto-instrumentation won't magically cross process boundaries.

ian: infra note: our nginx ingress can strip non-whitelisted headers. if X-Request-Id never reaches the app because the ingress removed it, nothing upstream can pass it along. double-check proxy_set_header.

clare: for onboarding samples we should do three things: (1) show explicit injection into job.meta (traceparent + x-request-id), (2) provide restore helper in worker bootstrap, (3) enable debug-safe redaction in sample env so tokens don't appear in local logs.

sam: plan: i'll add sdk-js helpers `enqueueWithContext(queue, job)` and `restoreContextFromJob(job)` plus unit tests. will also flip sample env var LOG_DEBUG_SAFE=true for the repo.

maria: opened a tiny repro PR for sample-apps: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/301 (WIP) that demonstrates both approaches — explicit meta and restore helper.

jordan: add a lightweight e2e: POST -> enqueue -> worker stdout contains same X-Request-Id. CI can run it with a fake worker container. catches regressions.

ian: i'll add ingress doc snippet and k8s annotation example: `proxy_set_header X-Request-Id $http_x_request_id; proxy_set_header traceparent $http_traceparent;` and a short troubleshooting checklist.

clare: on redaction: current node SDK skips scrubbers at debug. we should either always scrub or offer `LOG_DEBUG_SAFE`. recommend defaulting samples to safe mode. small scrubber pseudocode: ```js
const scrub = s => s.replace(/Bearer\s+\S+/gi, '[REDACTED]');
```
we'll refine patterns.

sam: logging perf benchmark shows light-weight scrubber adds <2% CPU on our sample loads. i'll attach numbers to the PR.

maria: thanks all. leaving this thread open for reviews. devex-bot: CI | sample-apps PR 301  checks queued: lint, unit, telemetry-e2e.

devex-bot: reminder: please add a short note in SDK CHANGELOG about the enqueue/restore helpers.
